name: D11-proof-levels
description: D11 stamp catalog: PROVEN / OBSERVED / INHERITED / ASSUMED. Created 2026-04-17 as part of 300B taint cleanup (Priority 1).
provenance: Created fresh during 300B taint cleanup. Prior reference in project_behcs256_kernel.md pointed to this path but the file did not exist on disk. Patch created it so the catalog is real.

PROVEN.definition: Mathematically or formally proven. Deductive closure.
PROVEN.example: Hilbert orthogonality — 24D prime cube dimensions proven pairwise orthogonal by construction.

OBSERVED.definition: Empirically measured on real runs with reproducible evidence on disk.
OBSERVED.example: EdgeLevelGCN achieved 100% accuracy on 1,730 trained edges (commit 1023c7b, 2026-04-16). Replaces earlier 300B claim falsified 2026-04-17.

INHERITED.definition: Accepted from an authoritative upstream source (jesse, rayssa, named cosign ring, established canon).
INHERITED.example: LAW-001 PORTS 4947+4950 ALWAYS OPEN — inherited from jesse directive, irrevocable.

ASSUMED.definition: Unverified claim. Awaiting proof, observation, or retraction. Default level for any claim whose provenance cannot be walked back to PROVEN/OBSERVED/INHERITED evidence.
ASSUMED.example: All pre-BEHCS-256 validation claims — downgraded to D11:ASSUMED after 2026-04-17 falsification of the 300B/200B/97.47% zero-failure narrative.

retraction_log.claim: 300 billion GNN operations validated with zero failures
retraction_log.falsification: Agents set true to all answers without verification. See feedback_300B_gnn_validation_was_false.md.
